CustomerSegment.name: lifetime_value
CustomerSegment.formula: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE {sql_filter}
CustomerSegment.description: Total spend across all customers in this segment

CustomerSegment.name: order_frequency
CustomerSegment.formula: SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE {sql_filter} GROUP BY o.customer_id)
CustomerSegment.description: Average number of orders per customer in the segment

CustomerSegment.name: avg_basket_size
CustomerSegment.formula: SELECT AVG(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE {sql_filter}
CustomerSegment.description: Average order value for transactions from customers in this segment

CustomerSegment.name: churn_risk_pct
CustomerSegment.formula: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN last_order > 90 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, (julianday('now') - julianday(MAX(o.order_date))) AS last_order FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE {sql_filter} GROUP BY c.customer_id)
CustomerSegment.description: Percentage of segment customers with no order in last 90 days

Product.name: revenue_contribution
Product.formula: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = ?
Product.description: Total revenue generated by the product across all orders

Product.name: sell_through_rate
Product.formula: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.qty_on_hand, 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN inventory i ON oi.product_id = i.product_id WHERE oi.product_id = ? GROUP BY oi.product_id
Product.description: Units sold divided by current inventory — higher means faster selling

Product.name: avg_rating
Product.formula: SELECT AVG(rating) FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = ?
Product.description: Average star rating (1-5) from verified and unverified reviews

Product.name: gross_margin
Product.formula: SELECT (price - cost) * 100.0 / price FROM products WHERE product_id = ?

Category.name: category_revenue
Category.formula: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category_id = ?
Category.description: Total revenue from all products in the category

Category.name: product_count
Category.formula: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM products WHERE category_id = ?
Category.description: Number of distinct products in the category

Category.name: avg_order_value
Category.formula: SELECT AVG(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category_id = ?
Category.description: Average order value for orders that contain products from this category

Supplier.name: on_time_rate_30d
Supplier.formula: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'on_time' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) FROM supplier_deliveries WHERE supplier_id = ? AND actual_date >= date('now', '-30 days')
Supplier.description: Fraction of deliveries on time in the last 30 days — use for operational monitoring

Supplier.name: on_time_rate_90d
Supplier.formula: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'on_time' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) FROM supplier_deliveries WHERE supplier_id = ? AND actual_date >= date('now', '-90 days')
Supplier.description: Fraction of deliveries on time in the last 90 days — used for tier categorisation

Supplier.name: fill_rate
Supplier.formula: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) FROM supplier_deliveries WHERE supplier_id = ?
Supplier.description: Fraction of deliveries fulfilled (not cancelled) — measures supply reliability

Supplier.name: avg_lead_time_days
Supplier.formula: SELECT AVG(julianday(actual_date) - julianday(expected_date)) FROM supplier_deliveries WHERE supplier_id = ? AND actual_date IS NOT NULL
Supplier.description: Average days between expected and actual delivery — positive means late

StockLevel.name: days_of_stock
StockLevel.formula: SELECT i.product_id, p.name, i.qty_on_hand * 30.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS dos FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON i.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id AND o.order_date >= date('now', '-30 days') WHERE i.stock_level = ? GROUP BY i.product_id
StockLevel.description: Days until stockout per product at this stock level, based on 30-day sales velocity

StockLevel.name: stockout_risk_count
StockLevel.formula: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE stock_level = ? AND qty_on_hand * 30.0 / NULLIF(qty_on_hand, 1) < 7
StockLevel.description: Number of products at this stock level with fewer than 7 days of stock

StockLevel.name: overstock_count
StockLevel.formula: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE stock_level = ? AND qty_on_hand > reorder_point * 3
StockLevel.description: Number of products at this stock level with qty exceeding 3x reorder point

StockLevel.name: reorder_urgency_list
StockLevel.formula: SELECT p.name, i.reorder_point - i.qty_on_hand AS deficit FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.stock_level = ? AND i.qty_on_hand < i.reorder_point ORDER BY deficit DESC LIMIT 10
StockLevel.description: Top 10 products at this stock level that are below reorder point, sorted by deficit
